workarounds.symptom: fix(hub): a planned restart sometimes fails the unit when the managed upstream dies from SIGTERM
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(hub): accept planned upstream SIGTERM stops. Target files: engines/hub/src/main.rs, changelog.d/2488.md. Planned restarts failed the hub unit on 2 of 3 production stops in #2487. The front reported a child terminated by SIGTERM as an error and exited 2. The replacement process started normally, with `NRestarts` remaining 0. (Ref: https://github.com/escoffier-labs/brigade/pull/2488)
